title: Lacasse as a first-chair trumpeter
summary: Russ describes Lacasse as a strict first-chair man, not a soloist, comparing him to George McCullum.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: What did Peter Lokos play like then?
Oh, but I mean, what kind? Would he be playing first? Would he be playing greatly?
He was a strictly first man. Was he—
Strictly. Did he get off at all? He was no solo man.
He got off to his own— He was a first chair man.
You couldn't find a better chair man. You like George McCullum?
He wasn't no hot man, but you couldn't find a— And what you want, your chair man is first.
Chair man is first. When you got to have— But you got to have a— You got to have a feature man on the side.
